premises.text: Most educational content is static and linear because dynamic interactive content is too slow and costly to produce while future learner needs are uncertain
premises.evidence_span: 98% of this content is both static and linear. Only 2% of it is dynamic. The reason for this is it takes such a lot of time and money to produce

premises.text: Knowledge AI generates interactive bite-sized e-learning packages vastly faster and plug-and-play ready for any learning environment
premises.evidence_span: With Knowledge AI, we're able to generate interactive bite-sized e-education, e-learning packages, 100 times faster, plug-and-play ready for any learning environment

premises.text: From source material the system generates a cascade of interactives, assessments, glossary, flashcards, quizzes, teacher materials, and export to learning environments
premises.evidence_span: It's created an interactive video that includes pop-ups of all the key terms, as well as quiz questions

premises.text: Knowledge LX generates full learning experiences for any learning goal in near real time via a latent concept space between current understanding and the goal
premises.evidence_span: With Knowledge LX, we generate full learning experiences for any learning goal in near real-time
